Now this matrix has first column with only one non-zero at row2 (1). The determinant of this transformed matrix (which is equal to original J because operations preserve determinant) is then computed by expanding along column1: sign = (-1)^{2+1} = -1, times 1, times the determinant of the 3x3 from rows1,3,4 and cols2,3,4.
